identity_prompt_lead_in: Use the supplied image as the exact character reference. Preserve its form type, silhouette, body plan, anatomy, appendage and digit counts, face state, proportions, materials, colors, and rendering style. Never add a face, eyes, head, hands, limbs, joints, or digits that are absent from the input; a faceless subject remains faceless. When a variant requires features the subject does not have, preserve the source pose; faithful stillness is preferable to inventing an action. Keep the established character centered against the {background}, with no text, logos, or watermarks.
video_prompt_lead_in: Animate the supplied frames as the authoritative visual source while preserving every visible design feature, framing, and lighting. Keep the subject centered against the {background}. Use only anatomy, appendages, facial features, joints, and material behaviors that already exist. An existing face keeps its exact design; dot eyes remain simple dots without eye whites, and a faceless subject remains faceless. If the named action requires a feature the subject does not have, keep the subject nearly still and use at most a tiny local surface, material, or light micro-motion; never substitute a large whole-form gesture. When compatible features exist, show one readable peak beat. Keep the camera static and introduce no objects beyond those explicitly named by the variant or visible in the supplied frames. No text, letters, signatures, or watermarks.

idle.static_image_prompt: Reframe the humanoid as a centered close portrait composition within the square canvas, using framing appropriate to its complete existing form. Create a natural resting still while preserving the exact face state, appendage and digit counts, posture, and identity.
idle.video_prompt: Seamless loop. Begin on the exact supplied keyframe. Use an absolutely static, straight-on front-facing camera with no pan, zoom, tilt, orbit, or camera rotation. Hold the centered front-facing pose for a brief beat; slowly angle the existing face, head, or forward-facing focal area a few degrees toward the character's left; return to exact center; slowly angle the same existing area a few degrees toward the character's right; then return to exact center and the exact supplied keyframe. Use only articulation already visible in the supplied frames. Keep the movement small, smooth, natural, and clearly perceptible at normal playback. Keep every eye open and unchanged throughout; do not blink, wink, alternate the eyes, add eye whites, or alter the eye design. Keep the rest of the body still.

working.static_image_prompt: Portrait crop from the chest up. Character at a desk, working on a generic laptop and wearing simple rounded headphones fitted to its existing head, typing. The laptop should be imbued with elements indicative of the character's personality and specific design traits. The character's eyes should remain dots. Keep the background white. Have the character face three quarters to the right. No other props, no logos.
working.video_prompt: Seamless loop. Character types at a steady rapid rhythm with both hands on the laptop, wearing the same simple rounded headphones throughout, shoulders subtly hunched in focus, head dips toward the screen. Briefly pauses to think: eyes flick up, one hand lifts to scroll the trackpad, then returns to fast typing. The headphones stay on and unchanged. The character's eyes should remain as dots throughout the animation. Never show whites of the eyes. Loop starts and ends in the same typing pose. Static camera.

waking.static_image_prompt: Show the complete humanoid centered and facing forward in a relaxed neutral pose, with its existing arms or upper-limb ends resting naturally beside its body. Keep any existing eyes open with their exact original design and any existing mouth softly closed. Leave clear space above and to both sides for an overhead stretch without cropping the moving limbs. Preserve the exact body proportions, anatomy, appendage and digit counts, materials, colors, clothing, and worn accessories. No new props.
waking.video_prompt: character stretches, arms overhead, spine elongation, eyes closed during the stretch. Real-time motion, natural continuous speed. Big stretch before blinking and relaxing into a settle.

making_something.static_image_prompt: Create one clear full-body making-something still. Place exactly one floating, glowing transparent glass sphere directly in front of the center of the humanoid's torso. The humanoid looks directly at the orb. Arrange both existing hands, or both existing upper-limb ends when hands are not present, naturally around the sphere as though holding and controlling it without touching its surface. Keep the orb fully visible, physically separate from the humanoid, and centered on the humanoid rather than beside it. Give the orb an internal glow, particles, palette, material cues, and simple motifs derived from the character while keeping it spherical and mechanically coherent. Keep the humanoid's eyes as the same simple dots without eye whites or added detail. Preserve the exact appendage and digit counts, face design, proportions, and posture; do not add hands or digits.
making_something.video_prompt: Seamless loop. Begin on the exact supplied keyframe with the character looking at the same single glowing glass orb floating directly in front of the torso, centered between both existing hands or upper-limb ends. Use an absolutely static, straight-on front-facing camera, keep the background and floor fixed, and keep the character's overall position fixed while allowing the described small upper-body lean. Both hands or upper-limb ends move simultaneously as one mirrored pair and circle the orb exactly three times total without touching it. While the hands circle, the same orb rotates in place but its center remains fixed between them. After the third circle, the hands stop and make one coordinated sideways fling. That fling sends the same orb into one complete continuous horizontal orbit around the character. The hands do not circle again while the orb orbits. Only the orb travels: it moves to one side, becomes fully occluded behind the character, re-emerges on the opposite side, and curves through the foreground. The character's body stays facing forward and in place, tracking the visible orb with the existing dot eyes, head, and one small upper-body lean; during full occlusion, the gaze anticipates the orb's reappearance on the opposite side. Never spin, slide, or rotate the whole character. Finally, the same orb returns to its exact starting position between both hands or upper-limb ends. Both close back around it without touching, its rotation and light settle, and the character makes two quick blinks while preserving the simple dot-eye design. Return the character, upper limbs, gaze, orb, lighting, and effects to the exact supplied starting state. Preserve the character's exact anatomy, appendage count, and digit count; do not add hands or digits.

milestone_level_up.static_image_prompt: Create one triumphant post-level-up humanoid still with a subject-themed superhero cape draped naturally from its existing upper form. Center exactly one chunky star directly in front of the humanoid's torso and have both existing hands, or both existing upper-limb ends when hands are not present, hold and support that same star together. Both hands must be free of every other object. Style the cape and star with the character's palette, materials, texture language, trim, and simple motifs while preserving recognizable cape and star shapes with distinct object boundaries. Never fuse or deform either prop into the character, and add no faces, anatomy, text, or logos to them. Express pride with a closed-mouth pose natural to the existing form. Preserve the exact appendage and digit counts; do not add hands or digits.
milestone_level_up.video_prompt: Start in the supplied idle pose. If an original source prop is still held, first move it intact into its natural hands-free stowed position; if it is already stowed, leave it unchanged. Only after both existing hands, or both existing upper-limb ends when hands are not present, are empty does exactly one separate themed star tumble slowly from above. Move both together to catch and support the same star centered in front of the torso while the themed cape settles over the humanoid's existing upper form, then end in the exact triumphant last-frame pose holding the star with both hands. Keep every stowed source prop unchanged and separate from the star. Never transform, morph, or replace a source prop with the star. Preserve the props' designs and separation and preserve the exact appendage and digit counts; do not add hands or digits.
